text:
Orbiton Systems has leased the Brevik ground station on the north edge of Port Halden, according to city records released Tuesday. The five-year agreement, signed with municipal property manager Lysa Verner, gives the satellite operator access to the site’s existing antenna array and fiber link for tracking and data relay services. The deal is valued at 4.8 million crowns over the term and is expected to bring six technical jobs to the area by early summer.

“Brevik is a good fit because it already has the infrastructure they need,” said Deputy Mayor Tomas Rind. “We expect the lease to support local employment without adding pressure on nearby neighborhoods.” The first equipment checks are scheduled for next month.
